grok.pulse: NQ is shut until the 6 PM ET Sunday open, and the weekend tape flipped more risk-off after @FirstSquawk flagged Iranian media reports of 3 Hormuz tanker explosions this morning on top of last night's unconfirmed Houthi Aramco/Riyadh claims — a CL-spike risk that undercuts last week's ~13% oil dump on de-escalation hopes, only partly offset by Friday's Comp bounce and oversold chips into Tuesday CPI.
grok.bias: risk-off — fresh Hormuz tanker-explosion headlines plus Saturday night Houthi Aramco/Riyadh claims raise an oil-shock risk into the 6 PM ET open, stacking on last week's AI/data-center rout (Nasdaq ~-3.4%, NQ ~-4.3% to -4.9%, chips ~-12%) and hot 165k NFP that lifted Dec hike odds toward ~75-80%; Friday's bounce is the cushion.
items: @FirstSquawk (~6:09 AM ET): Iranian media says 3 oil tankers were hit by explosions and caught fire transiting the Strait of Hormuz — Bearish NQ

@JTradesQuant (~5:49 AM ET): Oct jobs 165k vs ~65k, unemployment 4.1%, Dec hike odds ~75-78%; CPI Tuesday is the next NQ swing — Bearish NQ
@QuantApexAI (~7:07 AM ET): Chip index -12.1% on the week, Nasdaq-100 -4.9%, Thu erased $2.3T; Kospi -11.7% as Asia followed the AI rout — Bearish NQ
